# netbox_virtual_chassis_list (Data Source)

Lists virtual_chassis objects matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_virtual_chassis_list" "test" {
  filters = [
    { name = "name", value = "test-virtual_chassis" },
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes Set) Query filters, sent as API list parameters. Supported names: created, created__empty, created__gt, created__gte, created__lt, created__lte, created__n, description, description__empty, description__ic, description__ie, description__iew, description__iregex, description__isw, description__n, description__nic, description__nie, description__niew, description__nisw, description__regex, domain, domain__empty, domain__ic, domain__ie, domain__iew, domain__iregex, domain__isw, domain__n, domain__nic, domain__nie, domain__niew, domain__nisw, domain__regex, id, id__empty, id__gt, id__gte, id__lt, id__lte, id__n, last_updated, last_updated__empty, last_updated__gt, last_updated__gte, last_updated__lt, last_updated__lte, last_updated__n, master, master__n, master_id, master_id__n, member_count, member_count__empty, member_count__gt, member_count__gte, member_count__lt, member_count__lte, member_count__n, name, name__empty, name__ic, name__ie, name__iew, name__iregex, name__isw, name__n, name__nic, name__nie, name__niew, name__nisw, name__regex, owner, owner__n, owner_group, owner_group__n, owner_group_id, owner_group_id__n, owner_id, owner_id__n, q, region, region__n, region_id, region_id__n, site, site__n, site_group, site_group__n, site_group_id, site_group_id__n, site_id, site_id__n, tag, tag__any, tag__n, tag_id, tag_id__any, tag_id__n, tenant, tenant__n, tenant_id, tenant_id__n. Repeating a name sends that parameter once per value. Custom fields filter as cf_<field name>, e.g. cf_tier, with the field's own filter logic: loose is a case-insensitive substring match, exact an exact match. NetBox ignores names it has no custom field for, and such an entry does not narrow the result. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of objects to return from the API lookup. Defaults to 1000.

### Read-Only

- `virtual_chassis_list` (Attributes List) The matching virtual_chassis_list. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--virtual_chassis_list))

<a id="nestedatt--virtual_chassis_list"></a>
### Nested Schema for `virtual_chassis_list`

Read-Only:

- `comments` (String)
- `created` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. An object field holds the related object's id, e.g. "12", a multiobject field a JSON list of ids in any order, e.g. jsonencode([12, 13]). A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `description` (String)
- `domain` (String)
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `master_id` (Number) Id of the device acting as chassis master.
- `member_count` (Number) Number of members of the virtual chassis.
- `name` (String)
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `url` (String)
